typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

retriever.description: The Retriever for which the action was created.

asyncActionSpec.description: The {@link AsyncActionSpec}, necessary for submitting the action for the first time.

numTries.description:
The number of times this indexing action has been attempted. An action will only be attempted
{@link Genai.Retriever.ConfigFields#maxTries} times before it is ignored in future runs of
#processQueues.

indexNumber.description:
For a specific retriever, the index number of the action. This is used to determine the order in which
the actions are processed if two IndexActions have the same creation timestamp.

processedForFailure.description:
If the #asyncAction has completed with an {@link AsyncAction#error} populated onto the instance this would
most likely indicate a python process error such as out-of-memory. For these index actions the cron job will have to process them
on each run. These actions will not be retried but will have their source files transitioned to the `FAILED` state.

This field indicates a index action has already been processed for a failure and should then be ignored by the next run of
the #processQueues cron job.

passageCount.description: The number of passages in this indexing action.

startTime.description:
The submit time of this indexing action.
Will be refreshed every new attempt.

title: Mapping between a Retriever and all of the index actions run via AsyncAction
name: Genai.Retriever.IndexAction
